solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Harshness of a dirty hovel in which fairy is imprisoned

indicators.note: the fairy is locked up inside the hovel, so one word goes within the other

parts.note: a sty is a filthy dwelling, literally a pigsty
a peri is a fairy or sprite of Persian legend

explanation.surface: A grim description of a squalid shack where a fairy is held captive.
explanation.definitionFit: Asperity is roughness or severity of manner, a direct synonym of harshness.

clue.text: A romance at sea being filmed

indicators.note: at sea means confused or all over the place, so the letters get jumbled

explanation.surface: A love affair conducted on board ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done in front of a running camera is being filmed, an idiomatic equivalent.

clue.text: Church has said evensong initially — so no place for this?

definitions.text: Church has said evensong initially — so no place for this?

parts.note: oral means spoken rather than written

indicators.note: initially points to just the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: If the evening service is merely spoken, there is no room for the choir's hymn.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: a chorale is a sung hymn tune, so a said evensong would leave no place for it.
explanation.definitionFit: A chorale is a hymn tune sung in church, so a spoken service has no use for one.

clue.text: Huge comedian comes around front of stage

indicators.note: the comedian's word wraps around another letter

parts.note: a comic is a comedian

indicators.note: front of selects the opening letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A big-name comic walks round to the front of the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Cosmic, of universal scale, is used loosely to mean vast or enormous.

clue.text: Token advice to those wanting to engage Jolson?

parts.note: to sign someone is to engage them under contract
Al Jolson was the famous American singer and entertainer

explanation.surface: A tip for talent scouts hoping to hire the old star Al Jolson.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as an instruction to agents: SIGN AL, i.e. take Jolson on.
explanation.definitionFit: A signal is a sign or indication, so it can stand for a token in that sense.

clue.text: Man's hot spirit — sadly he dislikes his fellows

indicators.note: sadly here suggests things gone wrong, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A gloomy picture of a man warmed by liquor who still loathes other people.
explanation.definitionFit: A misanthropist is a hater of humankind, someone who dislikes other people.

clue.text: Merrily daft? Not a drunk seen round your old Welsh town

indicators.note: the jumbled letters are seen encircling another piece
drunk suggests the remaining letters reeling about into a new order
not instructs that the following letter be left out of the fodder

parts.note: thy is the archaic form of your

explanation.surface: A merry, silly drunk wanders about an old Welsh town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' looks like a noun in the surface but is the anagram signal; 'your old' is the archaic possessive. The town's Welsh name is spelt with a Y where English might expect an I.
explanation.definitionFit: Merthyr Tydfil is a former iron and coal town in South Wales.

clue.text: Traverse route differently to find stuff below metal detector?

indicators.note: differently tells us the letters are arranged another way

explanation.surface: Walking a path in a new pattern to unearth buried things with a detector.
explanation.definitionFit: Treasure trove is valuables found hidden in the ground, just what a metal detector seeks.

clue.text: President producing nothing great after liberation?

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

indicators.note: the letters of the word great are freed to take a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A head of state achieving little after a country is freed.
explanation.walkthrough: Daniel Ortega led Nicaragua after the Sandinista revolution, which suits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Daniel Ortega has been President of Nicaragua, so the name is an example of a president.

clue.text: Others won't need a nudge

indicators.note: won't need means one item is dropped from the word

parts.note: the remainder is the rest, the others left over

explanation.surface: Some people don't need prodding.
explanation.definitionFit: A reminder is a prompt or jog to the memory, like a nudge.

clue.text: Old bird's endless whine

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is cut away

parts.note: to moan is to complain or whine

explanation.surface: An elderly person's never-ending complaining.
explanation.definitionFit: The moa was a huge flightless bird of New Zealand, now extinct.

clue.text: Soldier finally buried in Polish tomb?

indicators.note: buried in places one piece within another

parts.note: to shine shoes is to polish them

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: A soldier at last laid to rest in a grave in Poland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' looks like the nationality; it is the verb to polish.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrine may be a tomb of a saint, hence the question mark marking an example.

clue.text: See Conservative with celeb status showing preference for a particular area

definitions.text: showing preference for a particular area

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or see
the A-list is the top tier of celebrities

explanation.surface: Spotting a Tory who has become famous.
explanation.definitionFit: A localist favours a particular locality, giving it priority over the wider whole.

clue.text: Time when wise man may lose his head

indicators.note: losing his head means the first letter is taken off

parts.note: a sage is a wise man

explanation.surface: An era when a scholar might be beheaded.
explanation.definitionFit: An age is an era or long period of time.

clue.text: Not the youngest-looking prisoner in bird

parts.note: grey hair makes someone look older
a lag is a convict, especially an old lag

explanation.surface: An ageing inmate shut up inside a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The greylag is a wild goose, the ancestor of most farmyard geese.

clue.text: Small room with restricted view

indicators.note: restricted means cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: a look is a view or glance

explanation.surface: A cramped room without much outlook.
explanation.definitionFit: Loo is British slang for a toilet, typically a small room.

clue.text: Scene of battle where elder possibly is cut off, holding fire

indicators.note: holding means the shortened word wraps around another
cut off means the last letter is removed

parts.note: the elder is one kind of tree
heat is the warmth of fire

explanation.surface: A battlefield where an elderly person has been isolated, under fire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Elder' suggests an older person, but it is the elder tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatre of war is the area where fighting takes place.

clue.text: Divine male hugged by Hollywood actress in tree

indicators.note: hugged by means one piece is held inside another

parts.note: Goldie Hawn is a Hollywood actress
Thor is the Norse god of thunder

explanation.surface: A god is embraced by a film star among the branches.
explanation.definitionFit: The hawthorn is a thorny shrub or small tree, also called may.

clue.text: A fortified drink served up in East is a poison

indicators.note: in a down clue served up means the word is read upwards

parts.note: port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: A strong wine is poured out in the Orient, and it turns out to be toxic.
explanation.definitionFit: Atropine is a toxic alkaloid from deadly nightshade, a poison.

clue.text: Room seen through the French window

indicators.note: seen through suggests one piece sitting within another

parts.note: le is French for the
an attic is a room in the roof

explanation.surface: A room glimpsed through a French window.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French window' seems one phrase; 'the French' gives LE and 'window' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A lattice window has small panes set in a criss-cross frame.

clue.text: Posy aims to wreck meetings

indicators.note: to wreck means to smash up, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A bunch of flowers intends to ruin some gatherings.
explanation.definitionFit: Symposia are conferences or meetings for discussion, plural of symposium.

clue.text: Sitting quietly on grass with nothing getting in the way

indicators.note: getting in the way means one piece intrudes inside the others

parts.note: p is piano, the musical direction for quietly
to sing is slang for informing, as to grass is
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: Sitting silently on a lawn with nothing obstructing.
explanation.definitionFit: Posing means sitting for a portrait or photograph as a model.

clue.text: Little son — what he should sit on, suffering from nappy rash?

parts.note: a little son is the abbreviation S
a potty is the small toilet a toddler sits on

explanation.surface: A toddler who ought to be on his potty because of a sore bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: Spotty means covered in spots, as a baby with nappy rash would be.

clue.text: With one having gone, member enters to show affection

indicators.note: enters means the piece goes inside the shortened word
having gone means a letter departs from the word

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
an arm is a limb or member

explanation.surface: Someone leaves and a member joins the group, showing fondness.
explanation.definitionFit: Warmth means friendly affection or cordiality.

clue.text: Little child in the wrong runs away

indicators.note: away means the runs letter is taken out

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A small child who misbehaves and dashes off.
explanation.walkthrough: The deletion signal is 'runs away': R (runs) goes from TORT.
explanation.definitionFit: A tot is a small child or toddler.

clue.text: No longer wanting country sport on estate as new development?

parts.note: to go off something is to stop liking it
a shoot is a game-shooting party on a country estate

explanation.surface: Someone tired of field sports on a country estate looks for a new venture.
explanation.definitionFit: An offshoot is a new branch or development growing out of something.

clue.text: Wild animals with fleshy bits crossing river

indicators.note: crossing means one piece lies across another, inside it

parts.note: hips are fleshy parts of the body
the Po is the main river of Italy

explanation.surface: Beasts with plump bodies wading across a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Hippos are large wild African animals, short for hippopotamuses.

clue.text: Maybe finger the idiotic extremists

parts.note: lunatic means crazy or idiotic

indicators.note: maybe suggests another possible arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: Perhaps point the finger at the foolish radicals.
explanation.definitionFit: The lunatic fringe is the extreme minority of a group, its extremists.
